judges.name: Hon'ble Sri Justice T. Venkatadri Somayajulu
judges.court: High Court for the State of Telangana
judges.temperament: Precise and quick. Reads the file before the matter is called and gets irritated when counsel is not ready with dates.
habits: asks about limitation and delay before hearing anything on merits
wants a one-page list of dates handed up at the start
dictates short orders in open court immediately after hearing
does not accept pass-over requests after the first round of calling

judges.name: Sri Kondapalli Vishweshwar, IV Additional Chief Judge
judges.court_hall: Court of the IV Additional Chief Judge
judges.temperament: Patient for the first two dates, then firm. Keeps his own register of who sought time and reads from it.
habits: grants a first and second adjournment freely but imposes costs (Rs. 2,000 to 5,000) on any third adjournment request by the same side
starts at 10:30 sharp and calls the list twice before lunch
prefers evidence to be recorded the same day the witness is present, even if it runs late

judges.name: Hon'ble Smt. Justice Aruna Lakshmi Pinnamaneni
judges.court: High Court for the State of Telangana
judges.temperament: Thorough and courteous. Records undertakings given by counsel word for word and checks them on the next date.
habits: insists on a synopsis for any matter where the paper book exceeds 200 pages
records counsel's undertakings verbatim in the order and asks about compliance on the next date
prefers short written submissions after oral arguments
continues interim orders only for a fixed period, never 'until further orders'

judges.name: Smt. Rajeshwari Doddapaneni, VII Additional Chief Judge
judges.court_hall: Court of the VII Additional Chief Judge
judges.temperament: Settlement-minded. Asks at almost every stage whether parties have explored mediation.
habits: asks whether the parties have tried mediation before framing issues or starting evidence
refers family property disputes to the Lok Adalat / mediation centre at least once
strict about amendment applications filed after trial has begun

judges.name: Sri Syed Irfanuddin Quadri, XI Additional Chief Judge
judges.court_hall: Court of the XI Additional Chief Judge
judges.temperament: Relaxed, heavy board. Many matters are simply not reached, but arguments once started are heard fully.
habits: takes up evidence and arguments only after lunch; the morning is for calls and I.A.s
matters beyond item 30 are usually not reached
asks counsel to point to the exact exhibit number during arguments

judges.name: Kum. Pallavi Tummala, III Junior Civil Judge
judges.court_hall: Court of the III Junior Civil Judge
judges.temperament: Recently posted, meticulous about procedure. Reserves orders on I.A.s and writes detailed reasons.
habits: checks service of notice and vakalat filing before anything else
reserves orders on interim applications instead of deciding the same day
returns papers for minor defects (page numbering, index) rather than condoning them

opposing_counsel.name: Sri Bhaskar Rao Gundlapalli
opposing_counsel.style: Procedural fighter. Rarely argues merits if a technical point is available.
tactics: files a fresh I.A. a day or two before an important date
objects to marking of documents on stamp duty grounds

opposing_counsel.name: Smt. Hemalatha Ravuri
opposing_counsel.style: Well prepared, formal. Takes maintainability and jurisdiction points early.
tactics: raises maintainability as a preliminary issue

opposing_counsel.name: Sri Ch. Venugopal Achary
opposing_counsel.style: Senior in years, carries a very heavy board across courts. Charming in court, hard to pin to a date.
tactics: seeks adjournments citing personal illness, usually through a junior or a letter
asks for the matter to be passed over and then does not return
files adjournment memos on the morning of the hearing

opposing_counsel.name: Sri Farooq Ahmed Siddiqui
opposing_counsel.style: Reasonable and commercial. Usually for builders and traders.
tactics: floats settlement figures in the corridor
proposes Lok Adalat when his client is weak on evidence

opposing_counsel.name: Sri Pradeep Kumar Jadhav
tactics: very long cross-examinations on side issues
seeks time when his own witness is not ready

opposing_counsel.name: Smt. Swathi Kolluru
opposing_counsel.style: Sharp, young, relies on paperwork gaps.
tactics: claims copies of filings were not served on her
serves her own documents in court on the day of hearing

opposing_counsel.name: Sri R. Dattatreya Sarma (Senior Counsel)
opposing_counsel.style: Senior counsel, excellent on law, mostly appears through juniors.
tactics: juniors seek pass-over saying senior is in another court
appears in person only for final arguments

opposing_counsel.name: Sri Imran Baig
opposing_counsel.style: Punctual and fair. Keeps to dates and concedes obvious points.
